Now, subtract the second result from the first:
\[ 2744 - 980 = 1764 \]

\[ 56 \times 49 - 28 \times 35 = 28 \times (2 \times 49) - 28 \times 35 = 28 \times (98 - 35) = 28 \times 63 \]
\[ 28 \times 63 = 28 \times (60 + 3) = 28 \times 60 + 28 \times 3 = 1680 + 84 = 1764 \]
